faq.a: Abdalla is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الله, whose core sense is abdalla; servant of god (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdalla?
faq.a: Abdalla is associated with Arabic. Abdalla is the Swahili form of Arabic عَبْدُ الله (ʿAbd Allāh), meaning 'servant of God'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الله is Arabic.
Abdalla can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdalla should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd Allāh is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdalla mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdalla is rendered عبداللہ and carries the sense عبداللہ، اللہ کا بندہ.

faq.q: What does Abdalla mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdalla is rendered عبدالله and carries the sense عبدالله، بنده خدا.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dal-la. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Abdalla?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdalla, abdalla. Script forms are عبدالله, عبداللہ, عَبْدُ الله, अब्दुल्ला.

faq.q: Is Abdalla a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
